comments.text:
Add a Vizia-based editor window to the nih-plug plugin using nih_plug_vizia.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.5 (DeviceState wiring)

IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Add nih_plug_vizia to Cargo.toml
2. Implement nih_plug::Editor trait using nih_plug_vizia::create_vizia_editor()
3. Create a root Vizia view that:
   - Receives the shared DeviceState (Arc<Mutex<>>)
   - Sets up a dark theme matching the web app colors (#0c0c1a background, #c0c0e0 text, #2a2a4a borders)
   - Creates a tab bar (Mixer / Surround / Routing / Tone Edit)
   - Shows a placeholder 'Hello from Integral' message initially
4. Verify the editor opens in a DAW with the correct size and dark background
5. Set initial window size to 1200x800

REFERENCE:
- nih_plug_vizia examples in nih-plug repo
- web/src/App.module.css for the dark theme colors
- Vizia docs: https://docs.vizia.dev/

title: VST: add Vizia editor window with nih_plug_vizia
